free_tier.stated: The smallest CPU instance example on the pricing page is a machine using tdx.large (4 vCPU, 8 GB RAM) with a 100 GB disk: compute is $0.232 per hour while running and $0 while stopped, and storage is $0.000139 per GB per hour charged while the machine runs and also while it is stopped. Prices are shown per hour and we charge only for the minutes your machine runs; there is no subscription and no minimum. GPU rental is by the hour with a minimum rental period. A welcome credit is only offered to some workspaces when they add a card.
